topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by connecting it to preceding histopathology practicals and outlining the day's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Discovery of Tumor Viruses and Cellular Proto-Oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how historical investigations of infectious tumor viruses established that cancer arises from the misregulation of captured normal host genes.

topics.label: Experimental Assays for Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the laboratory methods used in vitro and in vivo to evaluate whether specific genes or mutations confer transformed neoplastic properties.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Genetics of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the functional definitions, pathway impacts, and genetic behaviors that distinguish oncogenic from tumor-suppressive mutations.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the distinctions, molecular repair failures, and mitotic segregation defects underlying sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer.

topics.label: Multistep Mutation Progression in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes how stepwise acquisitions of oncogenic and tumor suppressor mutations drive the progression from normal tissue to malignant carcinoma.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Tumor Dynamics
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inherited germline mutations accelerate tumor development and influence ongoing tumor evolution during therapy.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session by referencing the covered learning outcomes and suggesting supplementary reading material.
